# CosMx
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dbscan)
library(ggpubr)
library(cowplot)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

domcol <- c( "gray13", "gold2", "plum4", "darkorange1", "lightskyblue2", "firebrick", "burlywood3")
names(domcol)<-1:7
cellcols<-c("#8DB600","#fdae61","#a95f96","#0067A5","#604E97",
            "#f46d43","black","#BE0032","cornflowerblue")
names(cellcols)<-c("B cells","Plasma cells","CD4 T cells","CD8 T cells",
                   "NK cells","Myeloid cells","unknown","Epithelial","Stroma")
classcols = c( "Endometrium" = "#c2a5cf", 
              "Endometriosis" = "#b8e3ad")


files<-list.files()
files<-files[str_detect(files,"bgclus")]
files<-files[-1]
metadata<-lapply(files,data.table::fread)%>%bind_rows()
i<-metadata%>%distinct(Run_Tissue_name,dom_nEndoh1_75)%>%
  count(dom_nEndoh1_75)%>%filter(n==1)%>%
  select(dom_nEndoh1_75)%>%unlist()
metadata<-metadata%>%filter(dom_nEndoh1_75!=i)
#metadata<-metadata%>%mutate(cl_corrected=ifelse(cl_corrected=="",cl_type,cl_corrected))
```

## blob size
```{r}
metadata<-metadata%>%filter(dom_nEndoh1_75==6)

samples<-unique(metadata$Run_Tissue_name)
#per sample
#eye selected, how to automatize??????
#samples<-c("6318B1-PT20"=7,"BEME005-3042A1-PT11"=9,"BEME209-Endometrium"=25,#15,
#           "BEME228-9152C4-PT14"=21,"BEME518_Endometriosis_1023-A2"=17,"BEME523-Endometriosis"=12,
#           "BEME541_Endometriosis-795R3"=11,"BEME550-Endometrium"=1,"BEME596-Endometrium"=46)
dom6<-metadata%>%split(by="Run_Tissue_name")
eps<-c(.05,.03,.018,.018,.1,.045,.0135,.05,.021)#overfitted 
names(eps)<-samples
dbcl <- lapply(names(dom6),function(x)
    dbscan(dom6[[x]]%>%select(x_slide_mm,y_slide_mm), eps = eps[x]))
names(dbcl)<-names(dom6)
blobs<-lapply(names(dom6), function(x)
  dom6[[x]]%>%select(Run_Tissue_name,cell_ID,x_slide_mm,y_slide_mm,
                     Class,Area.um2,cl_corrected,dom_nEndoh1_75)%>%
    mutate(dbcl=dbcl[[x]]$cluster))%>%bind_rows()
#blobs%>%ggplot(aes(x=x_slide_mm,y=y_slide_mm,col=as.factor(dbcl)))+
#  geom_point(size=1)+
#  facet_wrap(~Run_Tissue_name,scales="free")+
#  guides(col = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5)))
blobs<-blobs%>%mutate(Class=str_replace(Class,".+ e","E"))%>%
              mutate(Class=factor(Class,levels=c("Endometrium","Endometriosis")))
pA0<-blobs%>%count(Class,Run_Tissue_name,dbcl,name="Size")%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Size,fill=Class))+geom_histogram()+
    facet_wrap(~Class,ncol=1,scale="free_y",strip.position = "right")+
    theme_classic()+labs(y="Count")+
    theme(strip.background = element_blank())+scale_y_sqrt()+
    scale_fill_manual(values=classcols)+theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## blob composition
```{r}
temp<-blobs%>%filter(str_detect(cl_corrected,"B|CD|Mye|Plas|NK"))%>%
  count(Class,Run_Tissue_name,dbcl,cl_corrected,name="cells")%>%
  group_by(Class,Run_Tissue_name,dbcl)%>%
  mutate(total=sum(cells),prop=100*cells/total)%>%
  ungroup()

pB0<-temp%>%count(Class,cl_corrected)%>%
  left_join(temp%>%distinct(Class,Run_Tissue_name,dbcl)%>%
              count(Class,name = "total"))%>%mutate(prop=100*n/total)%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Class,y=prop,fill=cl_corrected))+geom_col()+facet_grid(~cl_corrected)+
    theme_classic()+theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                                strip.background = element_blank(),
                                plot.margin=grid::unit(c(0,0,-4,0), "mm"))+
    labs(x="",y="% of instances")+
  scale_fill_manual(values=cellcols)+theme(legend.position = "none")

pB1<-temp%>%ggplot(aes(x=Class,y=prop,col=cl_corrected,group=Class))+
    geom_violin()+
    geom_jitter(aes(size=total),width = .1,alpha=0.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values=cellcols)+
    stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",label="p.signif",
                       hide.ns = T,label.x.npc = .5,size=6,
                       position = position_nudge(y = -3))+
  facet_grid(~cl_corrected)+theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45,vjust = 1,hjust = 1),
        strip.background = element_blank(),strip.text.x = element_blank())+
    labs(x="",y="% per instance",size="Size")+
    scale_color_manual(values=cellcols)+guides(col="none")
#partB<-plot_grid(pB0,pB1,nrow=2,align = "v",axis = "lr",rel_heights = c(.3,.7))
#partA<-plot_grid(plot_grid(pA0,NULL,nrow=2,rel_heights = c(.75,.25)),partB,rel_widths = c(.25,.75))

temp<-temp%>%ungroup()%>%mutate(box=cut(total,breaks = 10))
formula <- y ~ x    
pC<-ggplot(temp, aes(x= total, y= prop, group=cl_corrected,color = cl_corrected)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", formula = formula, se = F,)+
  scale_color_manual(values=cellcols)+labs(x="Size",y='%',colour="Cell type")+
  scale_y_continuous(limit=c(0,NA))+theme_classic()+
  facet_wrap(~Class,nrow=2,scales = "free",strip.position = "right")+scale_x_sqrt()+
  theme(legend.position="none",strip.background = element_blank())

```
# scRNA
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(speckle)
library(limma)
library(ggrepel)
library(msigdbr)
library(clusterProfiler)

sc<-readRDS("data/fixed_annotated_aux.seurat.rds")
sc<-subset(sc,cells = which(sc$Class=="Peritoneal endometriosis"&
              !sc$harmonized_major_cell_type%in%c("Exclude","Erythrocytes")))
gc()
sc$has_LA<-ifelse(sc$LA_per_Sample>0,"LA+","LA-")
sc@meta.data<-sc@meta.data%>%
  mutate(Final_Immune_Cluster_ID=str_replace(Final_Immune_Cluster_ID,"Memmory","Memory")%>%
#           str_replace("Gamma-Delta","γδ")%>%
           str_replace("Cells","cells"))
aux_table<-sc@meta.data
```
## UMAP 
```{r}
alt_cellcols<-CellChat::scPalette(26)
alt_cellcols<-grDevices::colorRampPalette(alt_cellcols)(30)
names(alt_cellcols)<-sort(unique(aux_table$harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type))
names(alt_cellcols)<-str_replace(names(alt_cellcols),"-"," ")%>%str_remove("Plasmablast/")
cellcols<-cellcols[sort(names(cellcols))]
alt_cellcols[names(alt_cellcols)%in%names(cellcols)]<-cellcols[names(cellcols)%in%names(alt_cellcols)]
names(alt_cellcols)<-sort(unique(aux_table$harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type))
alt_cellcols<-alt_cellcols[names(alt_cellcols)%in%unique(sc$harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type)]

immune<-subset(immune,cells = which(!is.na(sc$Final_Immune_Cluster_ID)))
immune <- RunPCA(immune, features = VariableFeatures(object = sc))
immune <- RunUMAP(immune, dims = 1:10)
temp<-immune@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings%>%as.data.frame()%>%
  rownames_to_column("Cell")
temp<-immune@meta.data%>%select(has_LA,Final_Immune_Cluster_ID)%>%
  rownames_to_column("Cell")%>%inner_join(temp)

pD0<-temp%>%ggplot(aes(x=umap_1,y=umap_2,col=Final_Immune_Cluster_ID))+
  geom_point(size=0.1)+
  scale_color_manual(values=alt_cellcols)+
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3),ncol = 1))+
  theme_light()+labs(x="UMAP 1",y="UMAP 2",col="")+theme(legend.position = "none")
pD2<-temp%>%ggplot(aes(x=umap_1,y=umap_2))+
    stat_density_2d(aes(fill = ..level..), geom = "polygon")+
    facet_grid(rows=vars(has_LA))+
    theme_light()+theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
                        strip.text.y.right = element_text(colour ="black"))+
    labs(x="UMAP 1",y="UMAP 2")+scale_fill_distiller()
```

## Speckle
```{r}
props<-getTransformedProps(aux_table$Final_Immune_Cluster_ID,
                           aux_table$SampleName)
temp<-aux_table%>%distinct(has_LA,SampleName)
designM<-model.matrix(~0+has_LA,data=temp)#groups around 
colnames(designM)<-c("LAn","LAy")

props<-props$TransformedProps[,temp$SampleName]
fit<-lmFit(props,designM)
cont<-makeContrasts(LAy-LAn,levels = designM)
fit<-contrasts.fit(fit,cont)
fit <- eBayes(fit, robust=TRUE)
res<-topTable(fit,number = nrow(props),coef = 1)
res<-res%>%mutate(FC=2**abs(logFC) * sign(logFC))

pE<-res%>%arrange(FC)%>%
  rownames_to_column("cell_type")%>%
  mutate(cell_type=factor(cell_type,levels=cell_type))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=FC,y=cell_type,fill=FC,size=P.Value))+
  geom_point(shape=21)+
  scale_size(range=c(6,1),transform = "log10",breaks = c(.05,.1,.5,1))+
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#b2182b")+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(x="FC",y="")

#temp<-aux_table%>%count(has_LA,harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type,name = "cell_n")%>%
#    group_by(has_LA)%>%
#    mutate(total=sum(cell_n),prop=100*cell_n/total)
#temp<-temp%>%group_by(harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type)%>%summarise(cell_n=sum(cell_n),has_LA="Total")%>%ungroup()%>%mutate(total=sum(cell_n),prop=100*cell_n/total)%>%bind_rows(temp%>%mutate(has_LA=as.character(has_LA)))
#p0<-temp%>%ggplot(aes(y=cell_n,x=has_LA,fill=harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type))+geom_bar(stat="identity",position = "fill")+scale_fill_manual(values=unique(c(kelly.colours,cluster.cols)))

weird <- scales::trans_new("signed_sqrt",
       transform=function(x) sign(x)*sqrt(abs(x)),
       inverse=function(x) sign(x)*x**2)

names(alt_cellcols)<-names(alt_cellcols)%>%str_replace("Cell","cell")%>%str_replace("Memmo","Memo")
pE1<-immune@meta.data%>%count(has_LA,Final_Immune_Cluster_ID)%>%drop_na()%>%
  mutate(n=ifelse(has_LA=="LA-",-n,n),
         Final_Immune_Cluster_ID=factor(Final_Immune_Cluster_ID,levels = (pE$data$cell_type)))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=n,y=Final_Immune_Cluster_ID,fill = Final_Immune_Cluster_ID))+geom_col()+
  scale_fill_manual(values = alt_cellcols)+theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position = "none",axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),axis.ticks.y = element_blank())+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0)+labs(x="Cells",y="")
```

## DEG
```{r}
library(GO.db)

i<-aux_table%>%
  count(has_LA,harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type)%>%
  filter(n<100)%>%
  distinct(harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type)%>%
  unlist()
sc<-subset(sc,cells = which(!sc$harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type%in%i))

Idents(sc)<-sc$has_LA
deg<-lapply(unique(sc$harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type),function(x) 
    FindMarkers(subset(sc,cells = which(sc$harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type==x)),
                test.use="MAST",ident.1="LA+"))
names(deg)<-unique(sc$harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type)
deg<-lapply(names(deg),function(x) 
  deg[[x]]%>%rownames_to_column("gene")%>%mutate(cell_type=x))%>%bind_rows()
#data.table::fwrite(deg,"docs/has_laDEG-ct100-MAST.tsv")
deg<-deg%>%mutate(STATUS=case_when(avg_log2FC<=-1&p_val_adj<0.01~"Down",
                                   avg_log2FC>1&p_val_adj<0.01~"Up",
                                   TRUE~"NOT.SIG"))
temp<-deg%>%filter(str_detect(cell_type,"EnS|EnEp|theli|Mesen|Smoot",negate = T))

#temp<-deg%>%filter(STATUS!="NOT.SIG")%>%
#  count(cell_type,STATUS)%>%
#  group_by(cell_type)%>%
#  mutate(total=sum(n))%>%
#  arrange(total,cell_type)%>%
#  mutate(n=ifelse(STATUS=="Down",-n,n))
#temp$cell_type<-factor(temp$cell_type,levels = unique(temp$cell_type))
#pF<-temp%>%ggplot(aes(x=n,y=cell_type,fill=STATUS))+geom_col()+
#  scale_x_continuous(trans = weird)+
#  theme_classic()+theme(legend.position = "none")+
#  scale_fill_manual(values=c(Down="gray",Up="black"))+
#  geom_vline(xintercept = 0)+labs(x="DEG",y="")
temp1<-temp%>%filter(STATUS!="NOT.SIG")%>%mutate(STATUS=ifelse(STATUS=="Up","LA+","LA-"))%>%
    count(cell_type,STATUS)%>%pivot_wider(names_from = STATUS,values_from = n)
temp1<-temp1%>%add_row(cell_type=pE$data$cell_type[!pE$data$cell_type%in%temp1$cell_type])%>%
  column_to_rownames("cell_type")
temp1<-temp1[rev(levels(pE$data$cell_type)),c("LA-","LA+")]
pFA<-Heatmap(temp1,rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 2),cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, col) { grid.text(temp1[i, j], x, y,gp = gpar(fontsize = 10))},cluster_rows = F,cluster_columns = F,show_row_names = F,col=colorRamp2(c(1000,500,100,50,10,0),c("#14081D","#651B79","#de7065ff","#FFC28B","#FCFDBF","white")),show_heatmap_legend = F,column_names_rot  = 0)
pFA<-grid.grabExpr(draw(pFA))

temp1<-temp%>%filter(STATUS!="NOT.SIG")%>%count(gene,STATUS)
pG<-temp1%>%ggplot(aes(x=STATUS,y=n))+geom_violin()+
    geom_jitter(width = .05,alpha=0.5)+
    geom_text_repel(data=temp%>%group_by(STATUS)%>%slice_max(order_by = n,n=3),
                    aes(x=STATUS,y=n,label=gene),nudge_x = .08)+
    labs(y="cell types")+theme_minimal()

#enrichment
ranks<-split(deg,f = deg$cell_type)%>%lapply(function(x) 
  x%>%arrange(desc(avg_log2FC))%>%distinct(gene,avg_log2FC)%>%deframe)
gsea_bp<-lapply(ranks, function(x) 
  gseGO(x,minGSSize = 50,ont = "BP",keyType = "SYMBOL",
        OrgDb = 'org.Hs.eg.db',seed = T,pvalueCutoff = 0.05))
gsea_bp<-lapply(names(gsea_bp),function(x) 
    gsea_bp[[x]]%>%as.data.frame()%>%mutate(cell_type=x))%>%bind_rows()
#discard ancestors of enriched children
xx <- as.data.frame(GO.db::GOBPANCESTOR)
colnames(xx)<-c("term","ancestor")
xx<-xx%>%filter(term%in%gsea_bp$ID)
gsea_bp<-lapply(gsea_bp,function(x) x%>%filter(!ID%in%xx$ancestor))
#discard smaller set intersecting larger sets
temp<-lapply(gsea_bp,function(x) x%>%as.data.frame()%>%
               separate_rows(core_enrichment,sep = '/')%>%
               distinct(ID,core_enrichment))
temp<-lapply(temp,function(x) x%>%table()%>%tcrossprod)
temp<-lapply(temp, function(x) x/diag(x))
temp<-lapply(names(temp), function(x) 
  temp[[x]]%>%as.data.frame()%>%rownames_to_column("t1")%>%
    pivot_longer(-1,names_to = "t2",values_to = "prop")%>%
    mutate(cell_type=x))%>%bind_rows()%>%filter(prop>0)
temp<-temp%>%filter(t1!=t2&prop>=.8)
temp<-gsea_bp%>%distinct(cell_type,ID,setSize)%>%
  right_join(temp,by = c("ID"="t1","cell_type"))
colnames(temp)[2:3]<-c("t1","t1_size")
temp<-gsea_bp%>%distinct(cell_type,ID,setSize)%>%
  right_join(temp,by = c("ID"="t2","cell_type"))
colnames(temp)[2:3]<-c("t2","t2_size")
temp<-temp%>%group_by(t1,cell_type)%>%
  filter(t2_size<max(t2_size)&t2_size>t1_size)%>%ungroup()
temp<-temp%>%mutate(to_drop=t1)%>%select(cell_type,to_drop)%>%
  bind_rows(temp%>%mutate(to_drop=t2)%>%select(cell_type,to_drop))%>%distinct()
gsea_bp<-gsea_bp%>%mutate(IDtemp=paste0(cell_type,ID))%>%
  filter(!IDtemp%in%paste0(temp$cell_type,temp$to_drop))%>%
  select(-IDtemp)
write_csv(gsea_bp,"docs/has_laDEG-imm100_GSEA-BP.csv")
gsea_bp<-gsea_bp%>%filter(str_detect(cell_type,"EnS|EnEp|theli|Mesen|Smoot",negate = T))

#temp<-gsea_bp%>%mutate(STATUS=ifelse(NES>0,"LA+","LA-"))%>%
#  count(cell_type,STATUS)%>%mutate(n=ifelse(STATUS=="LA+",n,-n))
#pH<-temp%>%mutate(cell_type=factor(cell_type,
#                                   levels = levels(pF$data$cell_type)))%>%
#  drop_na()%>%
#  ggplot(aes(x=n,y=cell_type,fill=STATUS))+geom_col()+
#    theme_classic()+theme(legend.position = "none")+
#    scale_fill_manual(values=c(Down="gray",Up="black"))+
#    geom_vline(xintercept = 0)+labs(x="BP",y="")

temp<-gsea_bp%>%mutate(STATUS=ifelse(NES>0,"LA+","LA-"))%>%count(cell_type,STATUS)%>%pivot_wider(names_from = STATUS,values_from = n)%>%mutate(across(-1,function(x) replace_na(x,0)))
temp<-temp%>%add_row(cell_type=pE$data$cell_type[!pE$data$cell_type%in%temp$cell_type])%>%
  column_to_rownames("cell_type")
temp<-temp[rev(levels(pE$data$cell_type)),c("LA-","LA+")]
pHA<-Heatmap(temp,name="BP",rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 2),cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, col) { grid.text(temp[i, j], x, y,gp=gpar(fontsize=10))},cluster_rows = F,cluster_columns = F,show_row_names = F,col=colorRamp2(c(40,30,20,10,1,0),c("#14081D","#651B79","#de7065ff","#FFC28B","#FCFDBF","white")),show_heatmap_legend = F,column_names_rot = 0)
pHA<-grid.grabExpr(draw(pHA))


partB<-plot_grid(pB0,pB1,nrow=2,rel_heights = c(.3,.7),align = "v",axis = "lr")
```

## Metabolism
```{r}
library(scMetabolism)
sc<-readRDS("/media/Lawrenson_Lab_NAS/caipirinha/speed/share/fixed_annotated_aux.seurat.rds")
sc<-subset(sc,cells = which(sc$Class=="Peritoneal endometriosis"))
sc$has_LA<-sc$LA_per_Sample>0

#can't get it working with vision or ssgsea
sc<-sc.metabolism.Seurat(obj = sc, method = "VISION",
                         imputation = F, ncores = 6, metabolism.type = "KEGG")
#scmetabo<-sc@

scmetabo<-scmetabo%>%
  mutate(across(`Glycolysis / Gluconeogenesis`:`Drug metabolism - other enzymes`,function(x) 100*x))
temp<-split(scmetabo,by = "harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type")
designM<-lapply(temp,function(x) model.matrix(~0+has_LA,data=x))#groups around 
fit<-lapply(names(temp),function(x) 
  lmFit(temp[[x]]%>%select(1,4:88)%>%
          column_to_rownames("Cell")%>%t(),designM[[x]]))
names(fit)<-names(temp)
cont<-lapply(designM,function(x) makeContrasts(has_LATRUE-has_LAFALSE,levels = x))
fit<-lapply(names(temp),function(x) contrasts.fit(fit[[x]],cont[[x]]))
fit <- lapply(fit,function(x) eBayes(x, robust=TRUE))

res<-lapply(fit,function(x) topTable(x,number = 85,coef = 1))
names(res)<-names(temp)
res<-lapply(names(res),function(x) 
  res[[x]]%>%mutate(celltype=x)%>%
    rownames_to_column("pathway"))%>%bind_rows()

i<-scmetabo%>%count(harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type,has_LA)%>%
  filter(n<100)%>%distinct(harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type)%>%unlist()
j<-res%>%group_by(pathway)%>%summarise(logFC=mean(logFC))%>%slice_min(logFC,n=5)
j<-res%>%group_by(pathway)%>%summarise(logFC=mean(logFC))%>%slice_max(logFC,n=5)%>%bind_rows(j)
j<-j%>%arrange(logFC)
pJ<-res%>%filter(pathway%in%j$pathway&str_detect(celltype,"EnS|EnEp|theli|Mesen|Smoot",negate = T))%>%
    mutate(pathway=factor(pathway,levels=j$pathway))%>%
    ggplot(aes(y=pathway,x=logFC))+geom_density_ridges(alpha=0.1)+
    #geom_jitter(aes(col=celltype,size= adj.P.Val),height = .1,alpha=0.5)+
    theme_classic()+#scale_color_manual(values=alt_cellcols)+
    theme(axis.line.y = element_blank(),axis.ticks.y = element_blank())+scale_size(range=c(6,.5))+
    guides(colour = "none")+geom_vline(xintercept = 0)


partA<-plot_grid(pA1+theme(legend.position = "none"),pA2+theme(legend.position = "bottom"),pB+theme(legend.position = "bottom",axis.text.x = element_text(angle=0)),pBA,pF,ncol=5,rel_widths = c(.2,.2,.2,.15,.3),align = 'h',axis = 'tb')
partB<-plot_grid(pC,pD,pE,pG,ncol=4,align = "h",axis = 'tb',rel_widths = c(.2,.15,.45,.2))
```
